items.text: Among new graduate nurses in the residency intakes from October 2026 to October 2027 who complete the month-3 seminar, what are the sensitivity and specificity of a Transition Check score of 30 or below for separation from the hospital within 12 months of hire?
items.population: New graduate registered nurses in the four residency intakes from October 2026 to October 2027 who complete the month-3 seminar
items.intervention: Month-3 Transition Check score of 30 or below (index test)
items.comparator: Separation from the hospital within 12 months of hire, from human resources dates (reference standard)
items.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity at the pre-specified cut-off, with predictive values at the local separation rate
items.time: Index test at month 3; reference standard at 12 months after hire
items.setting: 640-bed regional teaching hospital nurse residency program

finer: Feasible with data already collected and approvals in hand; interesting to educators and human resources; novel locally; ethical with verbal consent and scores withheld from managers; relevant because the booster plan depends on it.
summary: One accuracy question with the index test, reference standard and cut-off fixed in advance.
